values.note: Neither the FS page nor recreation.gov gives a site count or length limit; listings say 10 sites. Two vehicles or one RV per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/goose-creek-campground (no site count or length) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165310 (none), read 2026-10-28; the stored count rested only on listings

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/goose-creek-campground ('No dump station, electricity or water hook-ups available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Potable water from a hand pump.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/goose-creek-campground ('Vault toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available'; 'No dump station'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend, weather dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/goose-creek-campground ('This campground is open from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend, dependent on weather'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Strictly first come, first served; a site must be occupied to be held, and almost every weekend fills (people arrive Thursday). Pay by cash, check, money order or recreation.gov Scan and Pay. Host at Lone Rock Campground.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/goose-creek-campground ('This is a strictly first come, first serve site'; 'All sites are first come, first served and must be occupied to be considered “saved.” Almost every weekend is full'; 'Scan and pay is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165310 ('first-come, first-served basis only'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $27 a site (two vehicles or one RV); $11 a third vehicle; day use $11. Senior/Access passes halve the site fee.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/goose-creek-campground ('$27 fee per site for overnight camping ... $11 for a third vehicle'), read 2026-10-28

note: South Platte RD campground at ~7,700 ft on Goose Creek, a green pocket that survived the Hayman Fire, ~11 mi west on graded gravel FR 211 (Matukat Rd) from Jefferson CR 126; about 2 hours from Denver. Next to the Goose Creek trailhead into the Lost Creek Wilderness (camping at the trailhead is prohibited); designated dispersed sites are posted along FR 211. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan and Pay listing: confirmed first-come only, vault toilets, hand-pump potable water, $27. Added no hookups/dump, season Memorial Day - Labor Day. Site count 10 cleared (listings only; no agency count or length). Website is the forest home page: own FS page given. Pin = FS point at the campground entrance. Note trimmed.
flags: Website is the Pike-San Isabel home page; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/goose-creek-campground.
Missing phone: South Platte Ranger District 303-275-5610 (FS page). Concessionaire line (303) 647-2366 (recreation.gov).
No agency length or site count: neither the FS page nor recreation.gov 10165310 (a Scan and Pay listing with no campsite catalog) states one. No 'small RV' wording either.
Road: FS directions give FR 211 (Matukat Road) for ~11 miles; no 4WD/high-clearance wording and no current PSICC alert names FR 211 or the campground.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): the FS says 'Goose Creek runs through the campground' - a small brook (a few metres wide) under canopy along the loop; sites may sit on its bank. Creekside re-audit lead; imagery can't see the bank under the trees. Not changed.
Operator: concessionaire-run (pass wording 'concessionaire-run campsites'; recreation.gov contact). Ownership federal stands.
